title: Russian Roulette
summary:
Russia's conflict with Ukraine can have major repercussions
Russia has accumulated troops along the border with Ukraine and there is widespread concern that Russia may invade its neighbor. We do not have any particular insight into the likelihood of a conflict, but we thought it would be interesting to think about the potential implications for the energy and shipping markets if an invasion indeed happens. have threatened Russia with sanctions if it moves against Ukraine.
